lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਅਟਵੀਅੰ ਮਹਾ ਨਗਰ ਬਾਸੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai ataveea(n) mahaa nagar baasa(n) dharam lakhyn prabh maiaa ||
lines.translation: The dreadful woods become a well-populated city; such are the merits of the righteous life of Dharma, given by God's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਯਾਲ ਚਰਣੰ ॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: saadh sa(n)gam raam raam ramana(n) saran naanak har har dayaal charana(n) ||44||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, the Lotus Feet of the Merciful Lord are found. ||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਜਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਅਤਿ ਬਲਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: he ajit soor sa(n)graama(n) at balanaa bahu maradanah ||
lines.translation: O emotional attachment, you are the invincible warrior of the battlefield of life; you totally crush and destroy even the most powerful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਮੋਹਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gan ga(n)dharab dev maanukhy(n) pas pa(n)khee bimohanah ||
lines.translation: You entice and fascinate even the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, gods, mortals, beasts and birds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: har karanahaara(n) namasakaara(n) saran naanak jagadeesvarah ||45||
lines.translation: Nanak bows in humble surrender to the Lord; he seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe. ||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਕਾਮੰ ਨਰਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: he kaama(n) narak bisraama(n) bahu jonee bhramaavanah ||
lines.translation: O sexual desire, you lead the mortals to hell; you make them wander in reincarnation through countless species.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਹਰਣੰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਗੰਮੵੰ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੀਲ ਬਿਦਾਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: chit harana(n) trai lok ga(n)my(n) jap tap seel bidaaranah ||
lines.translation: You cheat the consciousness, and pervade the three worlds. You destroy meditation, penance and virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਅਵਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: alap sukh avit cha(n)chal ooch neech samaavanah ||
lines.translation: But you give only shallow pleasure, while you make the mortals weak and unsteady; you pervade the high and the low.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਭੈ ਬਿਮੁੰਚਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: tav bhai bimu(n)chit saadh sa(n)gam ot naanak naaraainah ||46||
lines.translation: Your fear is dispelled in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, through the Protection and Support of the Lord. ||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਕਲਿ ਮੂਲ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਕਦੰਚ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨ ਉਪਰਜਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: he kal mool krodha(n) kada(n)ch karunaa na uparajate ||
lines.translation: O anger, you are the root of conflict; compassion never rises up in you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਯੰਤ ਜੀਵੰ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਜਥਾ ਮਰਕਟਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhaya(n)t jeeva(n) vasy(n) karot niraty(n) karot jathaa marakatah ||
lines.translation: You take the corrupt, sinful beings in your power, and make them dance like monkeys.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਨ ਤਾੜੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਹ ਤਵ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਧਮੰ ਨਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik saasan taaRa(n)t jamadootah tav sa(n)ge adhama(n) narah ||
lines.translation: Associating with you, mortals are debased and punished by the Messenger of Death in so many ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: deen dukh bha(n)jan dayaal prabh naanak sarab jee rakhyaa karot ||47||
lines.translation: O Destroyer of the pains of the poor, O Merciful God, Nanak prays for You to protect all begins from such anger. ||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਲੋਭਾ ਲੰਪਟ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਰਮੋਰਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਕਲੋਲਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: he lobhaa la(n)pat sa(n)g siramorah anik laharee kalolate ||
lines.translation: O greed, you cling to even the great, assaulting them with countless waves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਡੋਲਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaava(n)t jeeaa bahu prakaara(n) anik bhaa(n)t bahu dolate ||
lines.translation: You cause them to run around wildly in all directions, wobbling and wavering unsteadily.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਚ ਇਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਬਾਧਵ ਨਚ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਵ ਲਜਯਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach mitra(n) nach isata(n) nach baadhav nach maat pitaa tav lajayaa ||
lines.translation: You have no respect for friends, ideals, relations, mother or father.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਰਣੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਖਾਦੵਿ ਖਾਦੵੰ ਅਸਾਜੵੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਜਯਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akarana(n) karot akhaady khaady(n) asaajy(n) saaj samajayaa ||
lines.translation: You make them do what they should not do. You make them eat what they should not eat. You make them accomplish what they should not accomplish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਗੵਾਪ੍ਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: traahi traahi saran suaamee bigyaapt naanak har naraharah ||48||
lines.translation: Save me, save me - I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Nanak prays to the Lord. ||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੂਲੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੰ ਪਾਪਾਤਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: he janam maran moola(n) aha(n)kaara(n) paapaatamaa ||
lines.translation: O egotism, you are the root of birth and death and the cycle of reincarnation; you are the very soul of sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਤਜੰਤਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਤੀਰਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitra(n) taja(n)t satra(n) driRa(n)t anik maayaa bisteeranah ||
lines.translation: You forsake friends, and hold tight to enemies. You spread out countless illusions of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੰਤ ਜਾਵੰਤ ਥਕੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aava(n)t jaava(n)t thaka(n)t jeeaa dukh sukh bahu bhoganah ||
lines.translation: You cause the living beings to come and go until they are exhausted. You lead them to experience pain and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਯਾਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhayaan udiaan ramana(n) mahaa bikat asaadh roganah ||
lines.translation: You lead them to wander lost in the terrible wilderness of doubt; you lead them to contract the most horrible, incurable diseases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਦੵੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: baidy(n) paarabraham paramesvar aaraadh naanak har har hare ||49||
lines.translation: The only Physician is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God. Nanak worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਗਦ ਗੁਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: he praan naath gobi(n)dah kripaa nidhaan jagad guro ||
lines.translation: O Lord of the Universe, Master of the Breath of life, Treasure of Mercy, Guru of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਣਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: he sa(n)saar taap haranah karunaa mai sabh dukh haro ||
lines.translation: O Destroyer of the fever of the world, Embodiment of Compassion, please take away all my pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਮਯਾ ਕਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: he saran jog dayaalah deenaa naath mayaa karo ||
lines.translation: O Merciful Lord, Potent to give Sanctuary, Master of the meek and humble, please be kind to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰ ਸ੍ਵਸਥ ਖੀਣ ਸਮਏ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: sareer svasath kheen samae simara(n)t naanak raam daamodar maadhavah ||50||
lines.translation: Whether his body is healthy or sick, let Nanak meditate in remembrance on You, Lord. ||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣੰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarana(n) ramana(n) gopaal keeratanah ||
lines.translation: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet, where I sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਤਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadh sa(n)gen tarana(n) naanak mahaa saagar bhai dutarah ||51||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak is carried across the utterly terrifying, difficult world-ocean. ||51||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਮਸ੍ਤਕ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਾਯਾ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir mastak rakhyaa paarabrahama(n) hast kaayaa rakhyaa paramesvarah ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has procted my head and forehead; the Transcendent Lord has protected my hands and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਨ ਚਰਣ ਰਖੵਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam rakhyaa gopaal suaamee dhan charan rakhyaa jagadeesvarah ||
lines.translation: God, my Lord and Master, has saved my soul; the Lord of the Universe has saved my wealth and feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਭੈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab rakhyaa gur dayaalah bhai dookh binaasanah ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Guru has protected everything, and destroyed my fear and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤਹ ॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal anaath naathe saran naanak purakh achutah ||52||
lines.translation: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Master of the masterless. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Imperishable Primal Lord God. ||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਆਕਾਸੰ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੰ ਕਾਸਟ ਬੇਸਟੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jen kalaa dhaario aakaasa(n) baisa(n)tara(n) kaasat besata(n) ||
lines.translation: His Power supports the sky, and locks fire within wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਤੵਿੰ ਸਾਸੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਧਾਰਣੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jen kalaa sas soor nakhytr jotyi(n) saasa(n) sareer dhaarana(n) ||
lines.translation: His Power supports the moon, the sun and the stars, and infuses light and breath into the body.
